summary: **Around The Space** is an interactive, story-driven educational website designed to take users on an exciting journey through space exploration. The project focuses on discovering the historic and scientific importance of spacecraft, rovers, landers, and other human-made equipment left on the Moon, Mars, and beyond. Through immersive 3D visuals, interactive experiences, animations, and engaging storytelling, users can explore these forgotten robotic explorers, understand why they were sent into space, and learn about the discoveries they made. The website aims to make space science more interesting, accessible, and enjoyable for students and space enthusiasts. By combining technology, creativity, and real space mission information, Around The Space connects people with humanity's achievements in space exploration and inspires the next generation to learn more about the universe.
details:
Around The Space is an interactive 3D space exploration website that provides an immersive way for students and space enthusiasts to explore our solar system and learn about humanity's space exploration missions.

The website features a 3D solar system with the Sun, eight planets, moons, and other space objects. Users can navigate through space, zoom in and out, rotate their view, and explore different celestial bodies. Interactive information panels help users understand planetary features, spacecraft, satellites, and robotic explorers that have been sent to the Moon, Mars, and beyond.

A major focus of this project is bringing forgotten space hardware and historic missions to life through engaging storytelling. Instead of simply displaying scientific facts, the platform aims to explain why these missions were launched, how their equipment worked, and what important scientific discoveries they contributed to humanity.

The project is developed using React, JavaScript, Three.js, React Three Fiber, Drei, Lucide React, and modern web technologies. Three.js and React Three Fiber are used to create interactive 3D experiences, while Drei provides useful 3D components and Lucide React supports the user interface. Development is carried out using GitHub Codespaces and Visual Studio Code.

The creative aspect of Around The Space lies in combining realistic 3D visualization, interactive exploration, educational information, and storytelling into a single experience. The project aims to make learning about space more exciting, accessible, and enjoyable while inspiring curiosity about science, technology, and future space exploration.
